name: The Villaintine: Sepia
source:
After agreeing to limit herself to three days instead of her usual two-weeks stay on her assigned Villaintine's place, the Princess reveals her true intentions to the Villain as early as possible ([s]saves the time in explaining things and acting nice[/s]). He did accept the deal [s]but still persistently tries to communicate with her[/s]. And it's supposed to be all good and all, three days now looks good enough as a goal. 

Apparently, three days are not enough. Especially, when she sees dead flowers coming back to life and it triggers a memory of trying to pick some but watch as it wilts in her hands.  She can't possibly let this slide and not ask.  But who knows asking for something as simple as 'Why are these flowers blooming?' can lead to being The Villain's wingman. While that might sound simple, it's only simple if she doesn't get too attached. 

[From [url=https://niannn.itch.io/the-villaintine-sepia-demo] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
公主答应把在指定反派住处通常两周的停留限制为三天，并尽早向反派揭示了真实意图（[s]这样就不用花时间解释和装好人了[/s]）。反派接受了这笔交易（[s]却仍坚持与她交流[/s]）。一切本该顺利，三天看起来也足够成为目标。

然而，三天显然不够。尤其是当她看到已经枯死的花重新盛开，并想起自己曾试图摘花、却看着它在手中凋零时。她不可能对此视而不见，也不可能不问个究竟。但谁能想到，仅仅问一句“这些花为什么会盛开？”就可能让她成为反派的僚机？这听起来或许很简单，可前提是她不能陷得太深。

[来源：[url=https://niannn.itch.io/the-villaintine-sepia-demo]itch.io[/url]]
